source.attributes: Hypixel Wiki, Attributes/List/<rarity> — the `effect` field of each {{Attribute Table Entry}}.
source.slayers: Hypixel Wiki, Combat Wisdom — 'Each unique tier of Slayer bosses grants Combat Wisdom. Tiers I-III grant 1 each and tiers IV and V grant 2 each.'
source.lore: The items themselves. Armour, equipment and accessories state their Wisdom in lore, which this app already decodes.

note: Wisdom is never published as a total, only as its parts. These are the parts that can be read from a profile without guessing. What is NOT here, and cannot be: a Booster Cookie, active potions, the held item (which depends on what you happen to be holding), and the Ultimate Wisdom enchantment, which is a separate multiplier on Skill XP rather than a contribution to the Wisdom stat.

slayer.why: Counted on unique tiers ever slain rather than on kills, so one boss of each tier is the whole of it.
